purpose: Represent each gate as an exponentiated Yin→Yang→Yong braid/rope, recursively triangulated back into the same triad, with a quantum-radio research/control layer.

model.recursion: YIN→YANG→YONG→YIN forms the base braid; each gate and harmony point nests another instance.
model.quantum_limit: No claim of limitless physical radio bandwidth, dimensions, entanglement, or universe-scale propagation. The architecture is a software/control-plane design for quantum-radio applications.

quantum_radio.receiver_model: quantum-enhanced sensing/receiver pipeline where physical hardware is available
quantum_radio.calibration: traceable measurement metadata and continuous reconciliation
quantum_radio.limitations: Physical quantum-radio capability depends on real sensors, quantum interfaces, transducers, detectors, clocks, cryogenic/atomic hardware where required, and validated RF performance.

deployment.replication: unbounded logical software copies across discovered compatible surfaces
